udt_error_enum_v0.doc: Contract error types for the public key registry
udt_error_enum_v0.name: Error

cases.doc: A key is not 32 bytes long
cases.name: InvalidKeyLength

cases.doc: The owner is a contract address, which has no master key
cases.name: OwnerNotAccount

cases.doc: The note key is not a canonical BN254 scalar field element
cases.name: NonCanonicalNoteKey

cases.doc: The encryption key's y coordinate is not canonical
cases.name: NonCanonicalEncryptionKey

cases.doc: The owner already registered different keys
cases.name: AlreadyRegistered

cases.doc: The verifier refused the note key ownership proof
cases.name: InvalidProof

udt_struct_v0.doc:
User account registration data

Used for registering a user's public key to enable encrypted communication
for receiving transfers.
Not required to interact with the pool. But facilitates in-pool transfers
via events. As parties can learn about each other public key.
udt_struct_v0.name: Account

fields.doc: Edwards encoding of the X25519 encryption public key (32 bytes)
fields.name: encryption_key

fields.doc: BN254 note public key for creating commitments (32 bytes)
fields.name: note_key

event_v0.doc:
Event emitted when a user registers their public keys

This event allows other users to discover keys for sending private
transfers. Two key types are required:
- encryption_key: Edwards encoding of the X25519 key for encrypting note
data (amount, blinding)
- note_key: BN254 key for creating commitments in the ZK circuit
event_v0.name: PublicKeyEvent

params.doc: Edwards encoding of the X25519 encryption public key
params.name: encryption_key

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Proof that the registrant holds the owner's master key and the private keys
of both registered keys (note key + encryption/note_discovery keys).

All three are made over the registration digest `D`
udt_struct_v0.name: KeyOwnershipProof

fields.doc: Ed25519 signature by the encryption key over\n`sha256(ENCRYPTION_KEY_TAG || D)`
fields.name: encryption_key_signature

fields.doc: `keyOwnership` proof with public inputs `[note_key, D mod r]`
fields.name: note_key_proof

fields.doc: Ed25519 signature by the owner's master key over `D` (SEP-53)
fields.name: owner_signature

function_v0.doc:
Register a user's public encryption and note keys.

Registration is write-once: registering the same keys again changes
nothing, and different keys are refused. `proof` must show that the
registrant holds the owner's master key and both private keys.

Renews the registry by at most a day.
function_v0.name: register

function_v0.doc: Get the deployment's privacy key derivation domain.
function_v0.name: get_kdf_domain

udt_struct_v0.doc: Groth16 proof composed of points A, B, and C.\nG2 point B uses Soroban's c1||c0 (imaginary||real) ordering.
udt_struct_v0.name: Groth16Proof
